visualCharacteristics: question text + grey squared answer tiles; result pages with download links and "Erneut starten"; one page visible at a time (URL hash)
contentPattern: Rows: <page id> | page content [| answers-N]; questions | q1, q2, ...; rules | "condition = result" per paragraph (+ and, | or, ! not); fallback | page id. Answer links: "#<page id>" (direct) or "#<answer id>" (rules), answer id = <question id>a<n>.
